title: Expectation over constraint incidences
statement: Let $G$ be a regular Unique Games instance, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on its variable-neighbor incidences. Its edge expectation is the uniform average of $f$ over all such incidences.
caveat: The supplied snippet omits the definition of a regular Unique Games instance and its finiteness assumptions.
